profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Seattle Mariners | Baseball Operations
profile.summary: I've always been captivated by the junctions between people and technology, and I'm constantly building my knowledge of how to make data meaningful. I'm an AWS and Snowflake Certified Data Engineer with extensive experience in Python, SQL, and command-line tools, as well as being a polymath in a plethora of cloud technologies.
